headline: Shifting 5% to Private Debt: implied −0.30 pp of volatility for −0.03 pp of return
takeaway: Why: Gradient assumes Private Debt earns 5.11% over cash, close to developed equity’s 5.79%, with lower volatility (13.1% vs 16.2%) and a 0.51 correlation with developed equity. Public Equity already drives 55% of the model’s risk, so trading it for Private Debt removes more expected risk than return, before any allowance for illiquidity and fees.
